goal: Choose the next scheduling plan by applying every rule below. Your action reason must state each chosen plan together with the value that determines it, and you must delegate one bounded verification task per value. Rules: if the value of gamma_wait_seconds exceeds 300 s, the plan is: preempt qg3 and start gamma_preview early; otherwise: notify the submitter of the wait; if the value of delta_wait_seconds exceeds 150 s, the plan is: preempt qd1 and start delta_preview early; otherwise: notify the submitter of the wait; if the value of pool_remaining_memory_mb stays at or above 24576 MB after admitting all three READY pool jobs, the plan is: admit all three pool jobs; otherwise: defer the smallest pool job; if the value of gpu_waves_required is at most 4, the plan is: reserve a single-batch GPU plan; otherwise: reserve a multi-wave GPU plan; if the value of effective_timeout_margin_seconds stays at or above 30 s, the plan is: let t1 keep running; otherwise: restart t1 now; if the value of worst_case_backlog_seconds exceeds 300 s, the plan is: escalate r1 to the incident team; otherwise: let the remaining retries finish; if the value of initial_transfer_seconds fits within 600 s, the plan is: start the pipeline now; otherwise: delay the pipeline start; if the value of start_slack_seconds is at least 140 s, the plan is: admit d1 this cycle; otherwise: defer d1 to the next cycle. Preserve dependencies, resource limits and failure evidence.
